description: This file provides a set of functions to interact with a backend API, including methods for sending GET and POST requests, fetching work items, creating work items, and building URLs. It acts as a client API wrapper for the application's backend.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a JSON POST request to the backend and returns parsed JSON or throws an error.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Sends a GET request with optional query parameters, handling URL encoding and error responses.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Fetches work items from backend, optionally filtered by project ID.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item with specified attributes, following backend API specifications.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs a full URL for a given API path using the base URL.

ctags.name: createWorkItem
ctags.pattern: /^export async function createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priori/
ctags.signature: ({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
